commit.message:
Make `bullet demo` work without a working directory or an env var.

Running `bullet demo` from a directory with no `target/` failed with
"SQLite path contains an empty or non-normal component", which reads as a
corrupt install rather than a missing variable. Two causes.

The default data directory was the relative `./target/demo`, so where it
resolved depended on where you stood. Default to an absolute private path
under the user's state directory instead; BULLET_DATA_DIR still wins.

And `demo` created that directory with `create_dir_all`, which applies the
umask, so a default 002 left it group-writable and the ledger correctly
refused it for custody. Create it the same private way `farm init` already
does.

`bullet demo` now runs from anywhere with no environment set.
